content.title: Bloodhounds 2 Full Cast, Real Names: Who Plays What In Netflix’s New K-Drama? Bloodhounds Season 2 Cast DEETS
content.text: Bloodhounds 2 Full Cast, Real Names: After a gap of three years, Bloodhounds Season 2 finally premiered on April 3, receiving a strong and positive response from viewers. Fans have praised the gripping storyline, powerful performances, and unexpected twists that keep the drama engaging from the start. Set three years after the events of the first season, Bloodhounds 2 follows Gun-woo and Woo-jin as they return stronger and more focused than ever. The duo now faces a fresh and dangerous enemy, raising the stakes higher in this action-packed continuation. Not just in South Korea, the show is receiving a favourable response in India as well. BLOODHOUNDS 2 STREAMING PLATFORM: WHEN AND WHERE TO WATCH FULL EPISODES ONLINE? Bloodhounds 2 is now streaming on Netflix, allowing audiences in South Korea, India, and several other regions to enjoy the much-awaited series from home. The new season consists of seven episodes, all of which were released together on April 3, making it perfect for binge-watching. In India, the series became available at 12:30 PM IST on Friday, and fans have already started finishing the show within hours of its release. With a mix of intense boxing sequences, emotional storytelling, and strong character bonds, the latest season continues to keep viewers hooked. BLOODHOUNDS 2 CAST- WHO ARE THE LEADS OF THE KDRAMA? BLOODHOUNDS 2 CAST REAL NAMES: WHO PLAYS WHAT IN SEASON 2? Woo Do-hwan as Kim Geon-woo: A kind-hearted and disciplined boxing talent, Geon-woo is also a former Marine known for his strong values and loyalty. Lee Sang-yi as Hong Woo-jin: Geon-woo's trusted partner and fellow former Marine, always ready to stand by his side in every fight. Rain as Im Baek-jeong: A ruthless and powerful boxer driven by greed and control, determined to pull Geon-woo into the illegal IKFC circuit. Hwang Chan-sung as Yoon Tae-geom: A loyal enforcer working under Baek-jeong. Lee Si-eon as Lee Man-bae: Another enforcer in Baek-jeong's team. Lee Myeong-ro as Allen: A skilled hacker and the man behind managing the operations of the IKFC. Kwak Seung-hyun as LOL: An enforcer who also hosts the live streaming of the IKFC fights. Cha Ji-hyeok as Lee Woo-jung: A new junior officer in the Serious Crime Investigation Division. Hwang Dae-ki as Sun-bo: Assistant to Kwang-moo, supporting key operations.
